Name: Isshiah, Brother of Michah
Summary: Brother of Michah son of Uzziel, father of Zechariah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:25: Brother of Michah son of Uzziel, father of Zechariah in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: The mention of Isshiah in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
